mentions.name: MechaCraft
mentions.description: A vehicle building game where players construct and play with vehicles, released on CrazyGames as the developer's first released game. It currently has around 60 concurrent users, and ongoing polish and rework aim to grow that player base over the coming months.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on my vehicle building game https://mechacraft.io that I recently released on CrazyGames (my first released game!). It currently sits around 60 CCU which isn't great so I'm polishing/reworking things to see if I can increase it in the next few months.
